# ValidationResponse

The body of a 400: every reason the request was refused.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `validationFailures` | [`MaitentoValidationResult`](maitento-validation-result.md)`[]` | The failures, one per problem found. |

## Example

```json
{
  "validationFailures": [
    {
      "errorCode": "...",
      "memberName": "...",
      "message": "..."
    }
  ]
}
```
